biotools.summary: pycofitness is a Python-based software package for the in silico mutagenesis of protein and RNA sequences, utilizing coevolutionary analysis to predict the impact of mutations. It is designed for researchers with varying bioinformatics backgrounds and offers a user-friendly command-line interface.
